purpose: Teach: 柏崎/佐野/矢野/松永/白石/吉岡/小松/亀井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新潟県柏崎の発電所と取引を継続しろ
lines.en: Continue our business dealings with the Kashiwazaki power plant in Niigata.
lines.style: Direct, clipped authority. Decisive opening on the subject. No hesitation. Assumes immediate compliance. Measured pace, controlled breathing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新任の佐野部長を歓迎します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure to welcome the new department head, Sano.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, professional tone. Slight nod in the voice on 'understood.' Quick, efficient pacing. Confirmation without flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、営業の矢野課長の出張日程を整えろ
lines.en: Arrange the travel schedule for Yano, our sales manager.
lines.style: Decisive instruction, similar weight to the first line. Calm authority. Short sentences. Assumes the task will be handled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術担当の松永主任にプロジェクトを任せます
lines.en: Yes. I'll assign the project to Matsunaga, our technical lead.
lines.style: Prompt confirmation. Brisk, professional rhythm. Efficient delivery—no wasted words. The tone of someone executing a task cleanly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、広報の白石様の戦略を採用しろ
lines.en: Implement the PR strategy that Shiraishi has developed.
lines.style: Directive, measured authority. Weight on the verb 'implement.' Calm, unhurried. The tone of someone accustomed to being followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の吉岡様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the accounting closing schedule with Yoshioka from finance.
lines.style: Swift affirmation. Professional tone, even delivery. Slight emphasis on the action verb. Clean, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の小松様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Assign the new employee training program to Kommatsu from HR.
lines.style: Crisp directive, same register as previous commands. Composed authority. Deliberate pacing. No softening—this is an order stated clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の亀井様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll have Kamei from legal review the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly softer landing than the previous lines. Professional, orderly. A sense of closing out the meeting. Efficient, complete.
